summary: The agent implements a highly detailed deep learning solution with extensive feature engineering and a sensible log-transformation of the highly skewed target. However, it introduces a validation leak by calculating imputation and clipping statistics before the train/validation split, ignores the temporal nature of the dataset when splitting, and evaluates the model relying solely on the outlier-sensitive RMSE metric on the original scale.
